data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts the finite bound W(C)=c_3+c_{n-1} but provides no proof that checking amounts only up to this bound suffices. Requirement 2 explicitly demands: 'Prove it correct — in particular, justify why testing a finite, bounded set of amounts suffices, since the definition quantifies over infinitely many amounts.' The target states the bound as a bare claim with zero derivation or justification. Additionally, requirement 3 asks to 'State its worst-case time complexity as a function of n, the NUMBER OF COINS'; SRC_001 never states any explicit complexity formula (e.g., O(n·(c_3+c_{n-1}))), and does not definitively say whether a bound polynomial in n alone is achievable, only hedging with 'if a polynomial-in-n decision procedure exists (e.g. Pearson's).
